suggested_copy.description: Your Fortnite companion, wherever you play. Browse the live item shop, explore cosmetics, follow the latest news, and check player stats in one place.
suggested_copy.disclaimer: Daily Llama is an unofficial Fortnite companion app and is not affiliated with Epic Games.

claims_notes: Do not claim a verified number one ranking; the store description self-describes this but provides no ranking evidence.
Apple does not list download counts publicly. Google Play only supports 1K+ Android downloads; do not present as a cross-platform total.
Ratings are US Apple storefront values checked 2026-10-22, not global counts.
Store screenshots contain older game content; describe them as app previews rather than current season content.
